svg.text: 12 · The venue screen: open, teams drawn, the bracket live, champion (attendees in the hall)
Use case: the hall follows the finals without a phone; Moments shows the peaks, the bracket is a Pulse widget while the season runs

g.text: Demo Finals · teams of three, drawn for you
Scan to join · or /finals in Discord

svg.text: A takeover when the season opens and again before it closes: the count fills, the QR joins.
At the start: every team and its three players, then the bracket. Names follow the screen's names setting.
While the season runs, the bracket is the hero widget from the live round on (played rounds fold away); side

g.text: 2 – 1 against Team Alpha in the final

svg.text: The deciding game of the final ends the season: the champions' takeover with the three players.

Lobby codes never appear on a screen (U8). The legacy's two card windows (open for 15 minutes, started for 10) become the takeovers' durations, set per event (O4). Moments' 'finals' class ranks these takeovers; which rules and presets is L6 and
